examples.title: NVDA investigation synthesis
examples.prompt: Write a research synthesis of this investigation using only its findings and evidence; cite every claim.
examples.notes: Recorded before the latest grounding fixes (valuation findings pinned in the evidence, engine-computed valuation citations), so its valuation discussion is less complete than newer examples. Any per-share values it quotes predate a 2026-10-30 engine correction (balance-sheet, option and RSU figures last tagged years earlier are no longer used); the Valuation laboratory shows current figures.

sample_questions.question: Who manufactures NVIDIA's wafers and what are the risks?
What does NVIDIA say about export controls on sales to China?
Where does Apple assemble its products?
What does Apple say about tariffs?
How much is Microsoft spending on AI infrastructure?
What are Microsoft's main competitive risks?
What does Intel say about its foundry business?

valuation.note: Chosen by the DEEPTERMINAL author to demonstrate the engine; it is not an estimate of any company's cost of capital. In the Valuation laboratory you can set your own. Other inputs use the engine's documented defaults derived from each company's filings, each shown with its rationale.
